comments.body_html: What is the diference from AC’s - Attachment Compatibility Highlight.?

comments.author: awnova
comments.body_html: I didn’t like the feel of ac’s mods the UI didn’t look right lines extended past the cells they were supposed to box in. It layered a second icon On top of the main icon and changed its size to make it pop out more. I wanted to make something simpler that felt more vanilla. I also had an issue where the extra icon covered the tooltips.
